metadata.description: Claude Code mods: a band of readings above the prompt, a Mods panel, checks of answers and guards for what leaves the machine.

plugins.name: claim-check
plugins.description: After each answer, a second model sorts its claims by what backs them (this turn's tool output, an earlier turn, memory, reasoning, nothing), with every cited quote checked in code

plugins.name: context-band
plugins.description: A one-line band above the prompt that always shows how full the context window is.

plugins.name: mod-compact-marks
plugins.description: Says how full the context was before and after each compaction: under /compact's output, and in a toast for an automatic one.

plugins.name: mod-fold-output
plugins.description: Folds a long command output to its first lines, with its length in lines and tokens and a button that shows it whole.

plugins.name: mod-forecast
plugins.description: Forecasts the context window above the prompt: steps left to auto-compaction, a sparkline of the fill, and what the last step added.

plugins.name: mod-git
plugins.description: Shows the session folder's git state in the band: branch, changed files, ahead and behind, and the branch's pull request with its checks, review and comments.

plugins.name: mod-limits
plugins.description: Shows the subscription rate-limit windows above the prompt: how much of the five-hour and weekly limits is used and when each resets.

plugins.name: mod-machine
plugins.description: Shows this Mac in the band: free memory with the agent gate's live slots and budget, and the disk's free space.

plugins.name: mod-mission
plugins.description: Mission Control: one view of everything the mods know - context over time, limits, every session's runners on a timeline, sessions, the Mac and the pull request - with real charts where the surface draws them.

plugins.name: mod-mode-badge
plugins.description: Shows the model, the reasoning effort and the session's modes as one coloured badge in the prompt footer.

plugins.name: mod-prompt-hints
plugins.description: Turns the hint line under the prompt into what needs a look: a nearly full context, sessions waiting for you, a runner that died.

plugins.name: mod-quiet-tools
plugins.description: Hides the band's own tool calls (task_progress, runner_info) from the conversation: the band already shows what they say.

plugins.name: mod-runner-cards
plugins.description: Draws a background launch in the conversation as a card with the runner's live state and progress, read from the band's registry.

plugins.name: mod-sessions
plugins.description: Lists every live session in the band: its task, context and whether it waits for you; asks one for a report, sums this one up, and says what happened while you were away.

plugins.name: mod-task-spinner
plugins.description: While a turn runs, the spinner says the task's current step and percent instead of its word.

plugins.name: mod-tool-groups
plugins.description: Folds a finished group of tool calls into one line that says what was done, and opens it on a press.

plugins.name: mod-turn-stats
plugins.description: Adds a line beneath each long answer: how long the turn took, how much context it added and how many tools it called.

plugins.name: mods
plugins.description: Mod 0: a side panel that lists your mods and turns each of them, or all of them, on and off in every session.

plugins.name: outbound-guard
plugins.description: Stops a command that sends text out of this machine (a gh or glab post, a git push) when that text breaks a rule: an inline body, an em dash, an @-mention nobody approved, a key, or a client's name bound for a public repository.
